# acli-py filter

Work with saved filters.


## `acli-py filter list`

List your own filters (or your favourites).

```text
acli-py filter list [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--favorites`, `--favourites` |  | Your starred filters instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py filter search`

Search every filter you can see.

```text
acli-py filter search [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-q`, `--name` `TEXT` |  | Name contains. |
| `--owner` `TEXT` |  | Owner: email, name or @me. |
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Shared with a project. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |


## `acli-py filter view`

Show a filter.

```text
acli-py filter view FILTER_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FILTER_ID` | required | Filter id. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py filter create`

Save a JQL query as a filter.

```text
acli-py filter create [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--name` `TEXT` | required | Filter name. |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` | required | The query. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--favourite`, `--no-favourite` | `True` | Star it. |
| `--share` `TEXT` |  | Share permissions as a JSON array, or @file. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py filter update`

Change a filter's name, query, description or sharing.

```text
acli-py filter update FILTER_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FILTER_ID` | required | Filter id. |
| `--name` `TEXT` |  | New name. |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | New query. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  |  |
| `--share` `TEXT` |  | Share permissions as a JSON array, or @file. |
| `--edit-share` `TEXT` |  | Edit permissions as a JSON array, or @file. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py filter delete`

Delete filters.

```text
acli-py filter delete FILTER_IDS [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FILTER_IDS` | required | Filter ids. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors`, `--continue-on-error` |  | Keep going when an issue fails (else stop starting new ones); exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py filter star`

Add a filter to your favourites (or --remove it).

```text
acli-py filter star FILTER_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FILTER_ID` | required | Filter id. |
| `--remove` |  | Unstar it instead. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py filter owner`

Hand filters over to someone else.

```text
acli-py filter owner [FILTER_IDS] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--to` `TEXT` | required | New owner: email, name or account id. |
| `FILTER_IDS` |  | Filter ids ('-' reads them from stdin). |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read filter ids from a file (commas, spaces or lines). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors`, `--continue-on-error` |  | Keep going when an issue fails (else stop starting new ones); exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


## `acli-py filter columns`

Show, set or reset the columns a filter shows in the issue navigator.

```text
acli-py filter columns FILTER_ID [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FILTER_ID` | required | Filter id. |
| `--set` `TEXT` |  | Replace the columns with these field ids (repeatable). |
| `--reset` |  | Go back to the default columns. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |
